profile: WoW Forever / Skyborne Shaman. Candidate hierarchy with bounded episodic recall for the existing calibrated Hunt skills; NOT level 1-20 or general quest qualification. Existing runtime action restrictions and legacy cost estimates still apply.

hunt.question: Choose the next useful step toward `goal`. You may read task memory or a reference, enter a more specific decision, or use a currently offered skill. READ returns information, not an in-game action. Treat reference source conflicts as unresolved, not current observations. The remaining model-call budget is in `decision_graph`. `experience_index` says whether comparable retained episodes exist; READ:experience retrieves them. Enter improve only to label the latest matching episode for later offline study, never to claim a cause or edit live policy.

branches.search: Find/select an objective creature or choose how to travel toward one.
branches.improve: Classify one retained matching episode for later offline investigation; this does not change current skills or policy.

search.question: Choose how to find or select an objective creature using current visual cues and any loaded memory. Enter travel to select a direction or detour. Return to hunt when combat or recovery is the useful next step.

branches.travel: Choose local travel toward the quest area, a visible creature or a different heading.

travel.question: Choose a local travel step using the current position/quest area and any loaded navigation memory. These are short existing skills, not proof of a traversable path or safe terrain. Use a more specific heading decision if needed, or return to search.

branches.detour: Choose a detour relative to the quest-area bearing.
branches.compass: Choose a compass heading rather than an area-relative detour.

detour.question: Choose one currently offered area-relative detour, using observed obstacles and remembered blocked headings when available. A detour proposal is not a known path. Return to travel if none fits.

compass.question: Choose one currently offered compass walk using current observations and loaded navigation memory. Return to travel if a compass walk is not the useful next step.

improve.question: Choose one bounded follow-up for the latest matching retained episode. These outputs create a hypothesis/bookmark only; they do not diagnose a cause, rewrite code, change strategy or perform an in-game action. Return to hunt when no review is useful.

recent.summary: Read recent actions and their recorded outcomes, previous fight results and parent task memory. This is history, not proof of current world state.

progress.summary: Read the current objective list and progress from this input snapshot.

navigation.summary: Read recently blocked headings, units and calibration assumptions from this input snapshot. Missing map information remains unknown.

class_conflicts.summary: Read the repository's unresolved combat-pattern conflicts for the early-level Shaman. These are source-qualified references, not an executable rotation or newly learned ability.
class_conflicts.heading: ## Combat pattern

experience.summary: Read a bounded set of comparable retained episodes, including contrasting blocked/progress outcomes and per-action counts. They are observations from exact coarse context buckets, not causal rules or calibrated success probabilities.
